title: Ivo and the Promise
author: V. M. Fairweather
blurb: Edmund Joubert, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
